issues.jp_before: 首相[しゅしょう]{が|ga-subject}会見[かいけん]{で|de-place}その問題[もんだい]{に|ni-target}触[ふ]れる{や否[いな]や/が早[はや]いか/や|yainaya}、会場[かいじょう]{は/が|wa-topic}どよめいた。
issues.problem: Prime minister at a press conference touching on an issue is political content, which the rules exclude.
issues.action: Changed 首相 to 監督 (coach) and updated the English.

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]{は|wa-topic}ベッド{に|ni-destination}入[はい]った{が早[はや]いか/とたんに|gahayaika}、寝息[ねいき]{を|o-object}立[た]てた。
issues.problem: English 'he was breathing in his sleep' is unnatural.
issues.action: English changed to 'he was breathing softly, fast asleep.'

issues.jp_before: 私[わたし]{は|wa-topic}その写真[しゃしん]{を|o-object}見[み]る{なり/や否[いな]や/が早[はや]いか|nari}、思[おも]わず息[いき]{を|o-object}のんだ。
issues.problem: なり is normally restricted to third-person subjects; a first-person subject is a poor model sentence.
issues.action: Subject changed to 兄 (older brother); English updated.

issues.jp_before: 英単語[えいたんご]{は|wa-topic}覚[おぼ]える{そばから|sobakara}忘[わす]れる。
issues.problem: Same subject in both clauses with a dictionary-form verb, so the distractor なり ('forget the moment I memorize') gives nearly the same meaning.
issues.action: Replaced distractor なり with ばかりに.

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]{は|wa-topic}約束[やくそく]{を|o-object}する{そばから|sobakara}、平気[へいき]で破[やぶ]る。
issues.problem: Same-subject clause: distractor なり would be nearly synonymous.
issues.action: Replaced distractor なり with ばかりに.
